Which shortwave stations broadcast in Spanish?

In the A-26 schedule, 40 stations broadcast in Spanish. The most heavily scheduled include Radio Exterior España, Radio Habana Cuba, Radio Marti, Radio Romania International.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Spanish?

The most-used frequencies are 17715, 9690, 15500, 11760, 12030 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
